comparison.objective: Release and remove a hard drive from sprung carrier rails; candidate tunes an axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold a spring rail open while pivoting and extracting a drive versus hex-key unlocking, collar adjustment, relocking, and cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Drive safely removed and placed without rail breakage or shock; full final rubric is not present in the indexed body. Candidate requires controlled repeated impacts and retained setting.
comparison.reason: Both require bimanual counteraction, but extraction from sprung pins does not test commissioning or dynamic-response tuning.
